name: Nafisa Fai

bio.statement: Fai's board page identifies her as the District 1 Commissioner on the Washington County board.
Fai's pamphlet statement lists her occupational background as public health, public policy and community building.
bio.excerpt: Public Health, Public Policy & Community Building

bio.statement: Fai's pamphlet statement lists a bachelor's degree from Portland State University.
Fai's pamphlet statement lists service on the Oregon Maternal Mortality and Morbidity Review Committee.
bio.excerpt: Oregon Maternal Mortality and Morbidity Review Committee

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Fai says she strengthened public safety and supported first responders.
positions.excerpt: Strengthened public safety and supported first responders

positions.statement: Fai's pamphlet statement says she ended a homeless encampment through housing and services and prevented evictions.
positions.excerpt: Ended homeless encampment through housing and services, prevented eviction

positions.statement: Fai's pamphlet statement credits her with delivering the county's first climate action plan.
positions.excerpt: Delivered the County’s First Climate Action Plan

positions.statement: Fai's pamphlet statement says she will make data centers pay their fair share and safeguard tax dollars.
positions.excerpt: make Data Centers pay fair share and safeguard tax dollars

positions.statement: Fai's pamphlet statement says she opposes federal overreach and abuse of power and will defend the rule of law.
positions.excerpt: I oppose federal overreach, abuse of power and will defend the rule of law.

positions.statement: In a 2026 OPB article, Fai says she called for a state of emergency and pushed to reaffirm Oregon's sanctuary laws.
positions.excerpt: I called for a state of emergency, pushed to reaffirm Oregon’s sanctuary laws

positions.statement: In a 2026 OPB article, Fai says the county's path is to be more intentional about supporting both agriculture and other growth rather than choosing one.
positions.excerpt: The path forward is not choosing one over the other; it’s being more intentional about how we support both.

positions.statement: OPB reported in September 2026 that Fai proposed a moratorium on new data centers earlier in the year.
positions.excerpt: proposed a moratorium on new data centers earlier this year

collection_notes: Board page (washingtoncountyor.gov/bcc) lists Fai as District 1 Commissioner and Treece as District 2 Commissioner; neither holds the at-large Chair seat, so incumbent=false for this race. The board page also reports Chair Kathryn Harrington announced her resignation (Sept 2026), so the Chair seat is vacant/pro tem until the election. Pamphlet quotes are capped at ~125 characters by the fetch tool, so items use short excerpts.
